prompt_layout: image first, then the instruction (training and inference)
instruction: Extract the company, date, address and total from this receipt. Reply with JSON only.
lora_targets: vision + language layers, attention + MLP modules, dropout 0
optimizer: adamw_8bit, weight decay 0.001, max grad norm 0.3
collator: UnslothVisionDataCollator(model, processor, resize="max") + images column (CHANGED ON RUNTIME: pixel parity 0.0000)
labels: instruction + JSON answer trained, image tokens masked (GATE C)
loss_log: smoke steps 1-5: 2.56 -> 1.16; main run step 5: 0.98, step 155: 0.016 (from the training log)
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
sdpa_spotcheck: 0/100 prompts at length = 1 mod 32 (plain/fine-tuned and prompted); eager == sdpa on 3 + 3 receipts
